exact_items: The attention center cluster requires a canonical record family for project_attention_item

Minimum projection shape: attention_item_id, project_id, severity, owner_kind, reason_code, source_kind, source_object_ref, primary_route_payload, secondary_route_payloads[], display_title, display_subtitle, disclosure_visibility
This record family is absent from storage-plan.md and from Contracts_V0.md
notes: attention_item_id must be a stable opaque identifier suitable for deep-link / route-payload targeting

exact_items: Attention item rollup rules must be specified: when can N concern records collapse into one attention item, what is the severity-merge strategy, when must distinct items remain separate
Attention item disclosure rules must be specified: which items are shown inline on surfaces vs surfaced only on click vs hidden until the user navigates to the attention center
Routing rules from attention item to primary/secondary action surfaces must be specified
resume_url should be the serialized/transport form of a canonical route payload, not a separate identity system
Resume URL is generated from the canonical route payload; any deep-link or palette action using the same payload schema is equivalent
No doc currently defines this relationship or sets the canonical route payload as the normative form
Prompt_Pipeline.md §6.5 has a SSOT fracture: the rich runtime record (prompt bundle, runtime context snapshot, full execution identity) is described thoroughly in the pre-execution section
later handoff sections then collapse the same record into a few ad-hoc summarization fields and do not reference the canonical record
this means the durable prompt-pipeline trace record loses fidelity on the handoff path where corroboration, resume, and audit most need it
notes: §6.5 fracture means audit + corroboration + resume all reconstruct from incomplete handoff records — this is a systemic risk

exact_items: actor_kind and execution_role are missing from all runtime records, usage schemas, and stream-level events
both fields are required to support role-by-provider and role-by-account overrides, permission scoping, and governance-grade actor attribution
no canonical enum definition for actor_kind or execution_role exists in any planning doc

account_switch_event record family must be append-only and carry: old_effective_account_id, new_effective_account_id, switch_reason, scope (run/lane/session), old_account_pressure_level, new_account_pressure_level
account_pressure_episode record family must carry: account_id, pressure_kind, start_utc, end_utc?, peak_pressure_level, contributing_switch_event_refs[]
both families must be queryable from History, Ledger, and Usage Pressure projections
FinalGUISpec.md attention center widget needs: attention_item record binding, rollup display, severity badge, primary-action affordance, secondary-action list
Attention center must clearly separate concern attention items from non-concern attention items (e.g., model degraded, account health warnings)
Attention center must declare how it sources data: from projected attention_item family vs polling live concern record families
Identity actor envelope now has a minimal agreed shape: project_id + actor_kind + sparse actor refs + requested/effective identity block

The canonical actor envelope must be anchored in Contracts_V0.md and referenced by name from storage-plan.md, usage-feature.md, Provider_Stream_Mapping_External_Reference_A2A.md, and all runtime record schemas
Add project_attention_item projection family to storage-plan.md with canonical shape and projection freshness / trust-state contract
Add rollup rules (severity-merge, collapse criteria, forced-split criteria) to the attention item family definition
Add disclosure-visibility rules: inline surface, click-to-expand, navigate-to-attention-center
Bind attention center widget in FinalGUISpec.md to the projection family, not to live polling
Define actor_kind enum and execution_role enum in Contracts_V0.md with initial values to unblock persona resolution, permission scoping, and role-by-provider account overrides
Add both fields to the canonical actor envelope
Use actor_kind in stream events to distinguish overseer, executor, reviewer, corroborator, and observer roles
Fix §6.5 SSOT fracture in Prompt_Pipeline.md: handoff sections must normalize to the rich runtime record rather than collapsing it to ad-hoc summary fields
Add a normative rule: the durable prompt-pipeline trace record used in handoffs MUST include all fields from the pre-execution identity and runtime context snapshot
Remove or supersede any handoff summary fields that cause information loss
Add account_switch_event and account_pressure_episode families to storage-plan.md and Contracts_V0.md
Define the canonical switch-event schema with required fields (old/new effective account, switch_reason, scope, pressure levels, timeline)
Define pressure-episode schema and bind it to History/Ledger/Usage Pressure projections
